BRINKMAN_WALL_COUPLING.claim_tested: causal contribution of Brinkman damping to the residual/dynamics
BRINKMAN_WALL_COUPLING.scope_caveat: spatial overlap is measured; no Brinkman retuning or on/off A/B was run without a separate evidence trigger

CAPILLARY_DENSITY_SCALING.claim_tested: constant division by rho_l alone creates spatial curl or changes the residual/source fraction
CAPILLARY_DENSITY_SCALING.scope_caveat: does not clear the separate model-choice caveat about density-dependent inertia or projection; local-density scaling was not run

CAPILLARY_PRESSURE_IMBALANCE.claim_tested: the exact production-dtype capillary acceleration has a nonzero component outside the exact production pressure-gradient range in all three matched states
CAPILLARY_PRESSURE_IMBALANCE.scope_caveat: support establishes the force-subspace property only; it does not establish that this component caused the 60-degree contact-angle nonstationarity

CONTACT_LINE_PINNING.claim_tested: static pinning threshold or unpinning-force mechanism
CONTACT_LINE_PINNING.scope_caveat: 2dx and 4dx neighborhoods/exclusions are measured; no force-threshold test was run

DISCRETE_PRODUCT_RULE_IN_CAPILLARY_FORCE.claim_tested: the production centred-difference operator has a measurable product-rule defect in the Form-A/Form-B identity; the projected residual is explicitly split into the Form-B term and defect
DISCRETE_PRODUCT_RULE_IN_CAPILLARY_FORCE.scope_caveat: this is an exact algebraic decomposition, not evidence that Form B is a better model; no force replacement or variant trajectory was used

MOMENTUM_VISCOSITY_DISCRETIZATION.claim_tested: causal effect of the production viscosity operator
MOMENTUM_VISCOSITY_DISCRETIZATION.evidence: unmeasured; no viscosity A/B was run
MOMENTUM_VISCOSITY_DISCRETIZATION.scope_caveat: production nu(phi) and Laplacian remain unchanged

MULTIPLE_CONTRIBUTORS.claim_tested: joint causal attribution across multiple mechanisms
MULTIPLE_CONTRIBUTORS.evidence: no matched causal factorial ablation was run
MULTIPLE_CONTRIBUTORS.scope_caveat: mechanism closure is limited to the measured production-force subspace property

PHASE_KINETICS_LIMITED.claim_tested: whether phase kinetics also contributes to the observed L1A-2j nonstationarity
PHASE_KINETICS_LIMITED.evidence: L1A-2j retains PHASE_KINETICS_LIMITED=SUSPECTED; L1A-2k does not repeat or upgrade that classification
PHASE_KINETICS_LIMITED.scope_caveat: no phase-mobility or phase-equation ablation was run

PRESSURE_PROJECTION_LIMITED.claim_tested: production Poisson solve fails to remove the divergence of a production-gradient field or leaves a solve/reconstruction residual beyond dtype-aware roundoff tolerance
PRESSURE_PROJECTION_LIMITED.scope_caveat: the nonzero solenoidal residual is outside the projectable subspace by definition; it is not a Poisson convergence failure

TIME_SPLITTING_OR_DT_SENSITIVITY.evidence: unmeasured; frozen-state diagnostics were sufficient to localize the algebraic force residual

VARIABLE_DENSITY_COUPLING.claim_tested: whether a variable-density inertial/pressure model would improve the coupled dynamics
VARIABLE_DENSITY_COUPLING.scope_caveat: the one-step equal-density blend A/B is identical under the current gravity-off velocity formulation; no variable-density projection or inertia prototype was justified or run

WALL_ENERGY_MOMENTUM_CONSISTENCY.claim_tested: whether wall-energy thermodynamics and the full momentum/wall traction balance are energetically consistent
WALL_ENERGY_MOMENTUM_CONSISTENCY.scope_caveat: wall-energy-derived force is measured and localized; no wall-energy, momentum, or contact-angle formulation was modified

Y_PERIODIC_TOPOLOGY_COUPLING.claim_tested: causal contribution of y-periodic seam coupling
Y_PERIODIC_TOPOLOGY_COUPLING.scope_caveat: seam overlap is localized only; no boundary-topology ablation was run

equal_density_ablation.local_density_scaling: NOT_TESTED; no evidence trigger after rho_l is constant and equal-density blend A/B is unchanged
equal_density_ablation.variable_density_projection: NOT_TESTED; equal-density A/B did not justify a prototype

final_root_cause_scope: the measured structural non-projectable capillary-acceleration component only; not a causal explanation of the 60-degree angle-cycle/production-gate failure

identified_discrete_force_choice.discrete_identity: mu_h G_h(phi) = G_h(mu_h phi) - phi G_h(mu_h) - E_h, where E_h is the measured centred-difference product-rule defect
identified_discrete_force_choice.interpretation: The product-form capillary source is not generally a pure production pressure gradient when mu_h varies spatially. The measured residual is split algebraically into the diagnostic -phi G_h(mu_h) term and E_h. This identifies the force/operator choice behind the subspace residual, but does not show that either term causes the CHNS angle nonstationarity or that an alternate form is preferable.
identified_discrete_force_choice.pressure_projectable_subspace: range(G_h) for the exact centred periodic production gradient and constant-coefficient m2_proj pressure solve
identified_discrete_force_choice.production_form: +(SIGMA_NORM/We) * mu_h * G_h(phi) / rho_l, evaluated pointwise in pf.rhs and cast through the production momentum RHS

scope: diagnostic mechanism evidence only; not production validation and not a repair decision

checks.expectation: phi=1 inside (liquid), phi=0 outside (gas); dphi/dr<0; n_out=-grad(phi)/|grad(phi)| = +r_hat
checks.name: phi_orientation_and_normal

checks.expectation: mu = +dF/dphi (directional derivative); mu>0 at a convex liquid interface; int mu dphi = sigma_e/R
checks.name: chemical_potential_sign

checks.expectation: net capillary force at a convex liquid interface points toward the liquid: int F.n_out dr < 0
checks.name: korteweg_force_direction

checks.expectation: F = +grad(psi) is balanced by grad(P) with P = +psi (momentum carries -grad(P))
checks.name: pressure_gradient_convention

checks.expectation: pressure_field() is the projection pressure of step(): u* - dt grad(P) is divergence free
checks.name: diagnostic_equals_projection

checks.expectation: delta_p = P_liquid - P_gas > 0 and delta_p R We ~ +1 (probes: liquid core, far gas)
checks.name: laplace_jump_sign_and_scale

checks.expectation: the force integral -int F_r dr and the projection-pressure jump are the same quantity (catches any compensating sign in the diagnostic)
checks.name: force_integral_matches_projection_jump

checks.expectation: flow driven by the capillary force lowers F: -dF/dt = int mu u.grad(phi) > 0 (cos(mu grad phi, u) > 0)
checks.name: free_energy_consistency

checks.expectation: Form A (+mu grad phi) and Form B (-phi grad mu) drive the same flow (cos ~ +1); the solver force belongs to that class, not to its negative
checks.name: force_form_equivalence_class
checks.note: Form A and Form B differ by grad(mu phi) only in the continuum; on the grid the difference is O((dx/eps)^2).

checks.expectation: informational: for uniform (relaxed) mu Form A keeps delta_p R We = +1, Form B loses it (reduced pressure)
checks.name: relaxed_mu_form_choice
checks.note: Form A is retained: its projection pressure is the mechanical pressure whose jump is the Young-Laplace value for any admissible mu; this is a design argument, not a benchmark fit.

conventions.chemical_potential: mu = dF/dphi = f'(phi)/eps - eps lap(phi); mu = +eps |dphi/dr| / r > 0 at a convex liquid interface
conventions.grad_phi_direction: dphi/dr < 0 across the interface: grad(phi) points gas -> liquid (outside -> inside)
conventions.korteweg_force: F_cap = +(SIGMA_NORM/We) mu grad(phi) / rho_l  ~  -(SIGMA_NORM/We) phi grad(mu) / rho_l (up to a pure gradient); F . n_out < 0 (toward the liquid / centre of curvature)
conventions.laplace_jump: delta_p = P_liquid - P_gas = +sigma/R = +1/(We R); laplace_ratio = delta_p R We -> +1 (2-D)
conventions.phase_orientation: phi = 1 liquid, phi = 0 gas; phi(r) = 0.5 (1 - tanh((r - R) / (sqrt(2) eps)))
conventions.pressure_gradient: du/dt = ... - grad(P) + F; u+ = u* - dt grad(P), lap(P) = div(u*)/dt; static balance grad(P) = F
